ruleDefinitions.name: Metasploit SMB Authentication
ruleDefinitions.description: Alerts on Metasploit host's authentications on the domain. Note: Unmapped fields: LogonType, AuthenticationPackageName, WorkstationName, Workstation

sequences.query: (((event_id = 4625 OR event_id = 4624) AND LogonType = 3 AND AuthenticationPackageName = "NTLM" AND WorkstationName = RGX("^[A-Za-z0-9]{16}$")) OR (event_id = 4776 AND Workstation = RGX("^[A-Za-z0-9]{16}$")))
